diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
When enable_ssm is true, this self-managed node group installs and starts the SSM agent, but its autoscaling group does not wait for the SSM managed-instance policy attachment. Instances can start before the role has the permissions needed for SSM registration.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
When SSM is enabled, the self-managed node instances install the SSM agent and require the SSM managed-instance policy to be attached before they launch. :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng does not currently depend on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
When enable_ssm is true, the managed node group's launch template installs and starts the SSM agent, but the node group does not wait for the SSM managed-instance policy attachment. Nodes can start before their role has the permissions needed for SSM registration.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
When SSM is enabled, the managed node instances install the SSM agent and require the SSM managed-instance policy to be attached before they launch. :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng does not currently depend on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed.
